section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the limitations of the study, which involved a sample exclusively of Black older adolescent females from southeastern U.S. public universities, noting its lack of representativeness and cross-sectional design. It also highlights issues with missing data and the psychometric properties of body image flexibility. The section concludes by suggesting future research directions, including experimental designs and incorporating culturally-relevant dimensions of physical appearance dissatisfaction.
